'''Eirt Astar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], he was stationed in a small [[Rebel Base (Agrilat)|base]] in the [[Agrilat Region|Agrilat crystal swamps]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. Around this time, he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] agents.<ref name="SWG:RS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Eirt Astar was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:RS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Eirt Astar was added to the game with the revamped "[[W:c:swg:Imperial Theme Park|Imperial Theme Park]],"<ref name="SWG:RS" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Update Notes 6.12: September 13 2007|Chapter 6.12]]" update, on [[September 13]], [[2007]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 6.12: Masters of the Wild">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67417&month=092007|text=Chapter 6.12: Masters of the Wild}}</ref>

Although he wore a [[Rebel command insignia|rank insignia]] representing the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[General/Legends|general]] in the [[Alliance Army/Legends|Alliance Army]], he was referred to as Captain Eirt Astar.<ref name="SWG:RS" />
